motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: (Groan) The rhythm's all messed up now...

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: Our next performance will be more exciting...

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: They're looping a Christmas song over the PA system. It sounds nice, but it seems a little monotonous... Commander, want to hear a different version of it?

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: The pearl can only see the whole world when it's taken out from its shell. Can you hear the sound of rock from the shell casings?

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: While I was still in the factory, my creator believed that I could surpass all my predecessors of the same model and had high hopes for me. If I couldn't live up to these expectations, I'd despise myself.

motions.name: login
motions.line: You came just in time, I had a sudden burst of inspiration, so would you like me to hum a tune for you? ...Before that, though, what's today's schedule like?

motions.name: login
motions.line: You came just in time, I had a sudden burst of inspiration, so would you like me to hum a tune for you? ...Before that, though, what's today's schedule like?

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: A score can only be played when each and every note on it is in harmony. That being the case, I would be the most important chord.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: The concert's about to begin... Everyone, let them hear our song!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: I heard some really obscure heavy metal music when I was on my way to the café, but there was nothing but a mess by the time I got there. I wonder who was listening to it...

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: Are you on drums? Bass? Keyboard? I won't give up my spot as lead vocal!

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: You want to shackle my finger, which I play music with? <>Surely you understand what that entails, right, Commander...? <>Right, of course, I know that perfectly well... Then finally, have I lived up to your expectations?

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Want to hear my new song? ...Yeah, I wrote it just for you. This was the first time I felt so nervous about creating music. I just hope you'll like it.
